root_causes: Inefficient idle behavior: Agent 0 repeatedly executed Wait while the task objects and target stools were already known, leading to unnecessary steps and reward penalty.

Suboptimal exploration policy for Agent 1: Agent 1 continued to Explore[kitchen_1] even after the relevant objects and locations were identified, instead of transitioning to object manipulation and placement.

Lack of coordination/role switching: With two agents present, there was no effective coordination or explicit role assignment (e.g., one navigates, one manipulates), causing prolonged low-value actions near the end of the episode.
improvement_suggestions: Introduce a termination or goal-check mechanism that, once task propositions are satisfied or objects and target receptacles are located, switches agents from exploration/idle actions to a deliberate completion or episode-end action.
Refine the exploration policy to include a clear criterion for stopping exploration (e.g., when all task-relevant objects and receptacles are localized) and initiating pick-and-place subroutines.

Implement explicit inter-agent coordination or role assignment so that one agent takes responsibility for object manipulation while the other either assists (e.g., clearing paths, scouting) or remains inactive instead of aimless exploration.
Penalize prolonged sequences of Wait or redundant Explore actions more strongly, and reward shorter, goal-directed trajectories to bias learning toward efficient completion.

Add a state abstraction that tracks "task progress" (objects found, objects moved, receptacle reached) and conditions high-level policies on this progress to prevent looping behaviors once the environment is sufficiently explored.
overall_assessment: The task ultimately succeeded, but the trajectory contained substantial inefficiency with many redundant Wait and Explore actions, indicating weak high-level coordination and termination logic despite achieving the goal state.
task_instruction: relocate the kettle and potato from the counter to the stool in the kitchen.
